I've read all of `docs/adr/` (16 ADRs plus `README.md`), the two guidance files and the four sources you named. I edited nothing and changed no status.

The directory isn't a git repository, so I couldn't check who changed which status line or when. I could only verify things against the files.

## Bottom line

- **Rig → genai is a clean handoff at the decision level.** ADR-0015 replaces 0002 and 0003, and those two records point back to it. `crates/agent/Cargo.toml` matches 0015: it pins `genai = "=0.6.5"`, has no `rig` dependency, and its description cites ADR-0015. `CLAUDE.source.md` matches too. The leftover problems are outdated Rig mentions: `AGENTS.source.md` still states the old Rig rule, and five Accepted ADRs still mention Rig in their text.
- **Git remote / iroh has one real contradiction and one stale line.**
  - ADR-0001's amendment note says ADR-0014 makes git the main way to exchange data. ADR-0014 does the opposite: it rejects a git remote and keeps git only as local history.
  - `ARCHITECTURE.md` still allows network traffic to "le remote git partagé (co-MJ)". That contradicts ADR-0014, ADR-0016 and its own row L69.
- **No single consolidating Proposed ADR would be one coherent decision.** Details are in the last section.

## Consolidation verdict

No single consolidating Proposed ADR would express one coherent decision. Separate proposals are needed:

- **Rig/genai:** no new ADR. 0015 is already the consolidation; the remaining work is the documentation clean-up in #3, #7 and #8.
- **git remote / iroh:** don't merge. 0014 (what gets exchanged, and how it's filtered) and 0016 (the transport choice) can be accepted or replaced independently, which is exactly the separation 0014 argues for. A co-GM git remote, if you want one, is its own amendment to 0014.
- **Retrieval (0007, 0010, 0012):** at most one narrow proposal for the dense-search technology (#5). 0012's orchestrator and 0007's source weighting are separate choices that still stand.
- **Rights/projection:** its own proposal, already promised by 0014:49.

## Constraints in force today

- Local-first; no campaign server, real-time sync or runtime ACL (0001, 0014).
- The app works fully offline; history is local with no remote. Nodes exchange typed packets, filtered on the GM side before sending (0014).
- Transport is iroh with Ed25519 node identity. The rendezvous holds no data, LAN uses mDNS, and a portable bundle is the offline fallback (0016).
- `genai` only in `crates/agent`, and `genai::` only under its backend module. Thin `ModelBackend` interface, home-made tool loop (0015).
- All business logic and writes go through `tools/core`; MCP is an optional thin wrapper. The agent runs in-process (0004, 0008).
- ReAct loop with tools and tasks, no sub-agents in v1; model roles `chat`/`extract`/`compose` (0011, carried by 0015).
- One `memory_search` tool with lexical, entity, events and dense lanes. Results are merged by rank fusion (RRF). No GPU and no daemon (0012, 0010).
- Facts live in time-stamped session events with scope metadata; source-weighted scoring (0009, 0007).
- Obsidian-style `[[semantic_id]]` links with backlinks built in memory (0013).

Everything in the Accepted, Superseded and Amended statuses above stays exactly as recorded.
